impact: cmdBackup resolves configPath as path.join(ZUG_DIR, '..', '.zug', 'config') which equals ~/.zug/config only when ZUG_DATA_DIR is the default. If ZUG_DATA_DIR is set to a non-standard path the first lookup is wrong and only the altConfigFile fallback saves it. Both variables resolve to the same path in the default case — dead code.
resolution: cmdBackup() simplified to a single configPath = path.join(os.homedir(), '.zug', 'config') which is always correct regardless of ZUG_DATA_DIR. The redundant double-lookup that depended on ZUG_DATA_DIR for the config file was removed.
title: zug backup config path lookup is redundant and fragile when ZUG_DATA_DIR is set
